aiUsageIntro: We are committed to responsible AI usage and transparency in all our business practices. Heard uses AI to help moderate content and surface insights from community conversations. This page shows our real-time API usage — tokens consumed by day and by endpoint — so you can see exactly how we're using these tools.
aiUsageChartSubtitle: Total tokens consumed per day, broken down by endpoint.
aiUsageFooter: Data updates in real time. Tracking began June 2026.
obIntro: Heard is one of 10 finalists chosen by <org>{{org}}</org>, an initiative funding projects that strengthen democracy. A few quick votes could push us over the top.
obVotingTakes: Voting takes about 30 seconds. Here's how:
obStep1Desc: It's a Google Form. No login needed.
obStep2Desc: Past the intro and the project descriptions, until you reach the voting question.
obStep2Alt: Screenshot showing where to scroll on the form
obStep3Desc: Type the number {{number}} (that's Heard) in the first box, then hit submit. You can also put numbers in the next fields to vote for other projects. That's it!
obStep3Alt: Screenshot showing the number {{number}} entered in the first box
obRockStar: If you want to be even more of a rock star, send this to one other person and ask them to vote too. You have my everlasting gratitude. 🙏
obFooter: Thanks for helping out. The Heard Team 🐒
